title: The Hulk is in Doomsday
body: After months of Mark Ruffalo saying no, The Hollywood Reporter reports he's officially back as Bruce Banner. He last played the Hulk in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

title: Runtime: about 2½ hours
body: Brazilian outlet Omelete reports the cut runs 2h 29m 36s (about 149 minutes), the same as Infinity War. The Infinity Vision edition is said to run 2h 30m 55s, roughly 90 seconds longer because of one extra scene. Disney declined to comment.

title: Dec 16 internationally, Dec 18 in the US
body: Doomsday opens internationally on December 16, two days before its December 18 US debut. Before that, the cast heads out on a nine-city world tour that ends with the Los Angeles premiere.

title: The Avengers are back together
body: Kevin Feige told Empire that Doomsday reassembles the Avengers for the first time since Endgame, and it's the first time we see Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson lead the team.

title: Endgame: Encore is streaming
body: The extended cut is now on Disney+, with its new scenes bridging into Doomsday. It also has a newly added post-credits scene.
spoiler: The post-credits scene brings back Owen Wilson's Mobius from Loki. Wilson has since confirmed he's in Doomsday, though all he'll say is “You never know where Mobius is going to show up.”

title: Eyeing a $1B+ opening
body: Analysts on social media put global presales near $150 million and talk of the biggest worldwide opening ever, above $1 billion. These are unofficial tracking numbers, not studio figures.

title: The post-credits scene that sets up Doomsday
spoiler: The scene replays Wanda bringing Mount Wundagore down on herself at the end of Multiverse of Madness, then keeps going. Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom lifts the rubble off her and says, roughly, “Scarlet Witch, awaken. Your power will be mine.” Wanda gasps and opens her eyes.
Some outlets describe her eyes glowing Doom-green, which would suggest she's under his control. The press weren't shown the scene ahead of time.

spoiler.label: What it means:
spoiler.text: Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda is effectively confirmed for Doomsday, and possibly under Doom's control. In the comics, Wiccan and Speed have to rescue Wanda from Doom (Avengers: The Children's Crusade). Fans think the masked Latverian witches in Doomsday's marketing could be connected.

title: How VisionQuest ended
spoilerList: The Client (also played by James Spader) is shot down. Jocasta dies, but first she frees Ultron into a body made of nanobots.
Ultron turns on humanity. Vision traps him in a Mindscape sitcom, “UltraVision,” and both burn out. Vision dies.
Billy (Joe Locke) arrives, and he and Tommy revive Vision together. Vision is back in his classic green-and-yellow look and calls them both his sons.
Tommy asks if they'll see their mother again. Vision: they've said goodbye before, so they'll say hello again.
Post-credits 1: Ultron, alive and undecided between the Louvre and wiping out humanity, is holding Jocasta's consciousness.

title: Thor's yellow lightning
body: A Doomsday billboard spotted in Shanghai shows Thor with yellow lightning instead of blue, while Steve Rogers holds Mjolnir. Fans read it as the Odinforce. Marvel hasn't confirmed anything.

title: Did Mackie spoil Vision?
body: Anthony Mackie said he “got to hang out with” Paul Bettany while filming Doomsday. On The Tonight Show he walked it back: he never said Bettany was in the film, and he was “next door” while Bettany shot his own show.

title: Stitch toys tease more
body: A Hot Toys Stitch × Doomsday Cosbi line includes Scarlet Witch (set up in VisionQuest's finale), plus Thanos and Ghost Rider, neither of whom has been announced.
